name: 23824 · Blackstone, VA
findings: ZIP 23824 (Blackstone) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23824 (Blackstone) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23824 (Blackstone) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
